var GOOGLE_NEWS_MAX_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 24 * 60 * 60;
var GoogleNewsRateLimitError = class extends Error {
  static {
    __name(this, "GoogleNewsRateLimitError");
  }
  constructor(retryAfterSeconds, diagnosticMessage = "") {
    super((diagnosticMessage ? diagnosticMessage + " " : "") + "Pausing further RSS requests for about " + retryAfterSeconds + " seconds.");
    this.name = "GoogleNewsRateLimitError";
    this.retryAfterSeconds = retryAfterSeconds;
  }
};

function makeGoogleNewsUrl(query) {
  return "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(query) + "&hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN:en";
}

var INDIA_STARTUPS_SOURCE = CATEGORY_NEWS_SOURCES.find((source) => source.categoryId === "startup");
async function runAllCategoryNewsDeliveries(env, channels, afterChannelDelivery) {
  const channelByCategory = new Map(channels.map((channel) => [String(channel.id), channel]));
  for (const source of CATEGORY_NEWS_SOURCES) {
    const channel = channelByCategory.get(source.categoryId);
    if (!channel || !channel.telegram_chat_id) {
      console.error(source.topic + " delivery skipped: active Telegram channel mapping is missing.");
      continue;
    }
    const status = await runCategoryNewsDelivery(env, source, String(channel.telegram_chat_id));
    if (afterChannelDelivery) {
      try {
        await afterChannelDelivery(channel, status);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Post-news channel action failed for " + channel.title + ":", String(error));
      }
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
  }
}
__name(runAllCategoryNewsDeliveries, "runAllCategoryNewsDeliveries");
async function sendCategoryNewsTest(env, categoryId, channel) {
  const source = CATEGORY_NEWS_SOURCES.find((item) => item.categoryId === categoryId);
  if (!source) {
    return { category: categoryId, title: categoryId, status: "failed", error: "Unknown news category." };
  }
  if (!channel?.telegram_chat_id) {
    return { category: categoryId, title: source.topic, status: "failed", error: "Active Telegram channel mapping is missing." };
  }
  try {
    if (!env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) throw new Error("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not configured.");
    if (!env.GEMINI_API_KEY) throw new Error("GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.");
    const articles = await fetchGoogleNewsArticles(env, source.googleNewsUrl);
    const stories = await summarizeArticles(env.GEMINI_API_KEY, source.topic, articles);
    const message = buildNewsMessage(source.topic + " \u2014 TEST DELIVERY", stories, articles);
    const messageIds = await sendNewsMessage(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, String(channel.telegram_chat_id), message);
    return {
      category: source.categoryId,
      title: channel.title || source.topic,
      status: "sent",
      storyCount: stories.length,
      messageIds
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      category: source.categoryId,
      title: channel.title || source.topic,
      status: "failed",
      error: String(error?.message || error || "Unknown error").replace(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "__NO_TELEGRAM_TOKEN__", "[REDACTED]").replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 250)
    };
  }
}
__name(sendCategoryNewsTest, "sendCategoryNewsTest");
async function sendAllCategoryNewsTests(env, channels, onChannelResult) {
  const channelByCategory = new Map(channels.map((channel) => [String(channel.id), channel]));
  const results = [];
  for (const source of CATEGORY_NEWS_SOURCES) {
    const result = await sendCategoryNewsTest(env, source.categoryId, channelByCategory.get(source.categoryId) || null);
    results.push(result);
    if (onChannelResult) {
      try {
        await onChannelResult(result);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Could not save all-channel news test progress:", String(error));
      }
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
  }
  return results;
}

async function retryBankingFintechNewsDelivery(env) {
  const channel = await env.DB.prepare(
    "SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM managed_categories WHERE id = 'banking-fintech' AND active = 1 LIMIT 1"
  ).first();
  if (!channel?.telegram_chat_id) {
    throw new Error("The Banking and Fintech Telegram channel is not configured or active.");
  }
  const { date } = getIndiaDateAndTime(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date());
  const key = "telegram_news_delivery:banking-fintech:" + date;
  const record = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?").bind(key).first();
  const current = String(record?.value || "");
  if (!current.startsWith("failed:")) {
    return {
      status: current.startsWith("sent:") ? "sent" : current === "sending" ? "sending" : "not_failed",
      message: "Retry not started: today's Banking and Fintech delivery is not marked failed."
    };
  }
  const status = await runCategoryNewsDelivery(env, CATEGORY_NEWS_SOURCES.find((source) => source.categoryId === "banking-fintech"), String(channel.telegram_chat_id), true);
  return {
    status,
    message: status === "sent" ? "Banking and Fintech daily news was successfully delivered." : status === "failed" ? "The retry failed. The category remains marked failed." : "The retry was not started because the delivery status changed."
  };
}
__name(retryBankingFintechNewsDelivery, "retryBankingFintechNewsDelivery");
async function runCategoryNewsDelivery(env, source, telegramChannelId, manualRetry = false) {
  if (!env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) {
    console.error(source.topic + " delivery skipped: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not configured.");
    return "skipped";
  }
  if (!env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
    console.error(source.topic + " delivery skipped: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.");
    return "skipped";
  }
  if (!telegramChannelId) {
    console.error(source.topic + " delivery skipped: its Telegram channel ID is missing.");
    return "skipped";
  }
  const { date, time } = getIndiaDateAndTime(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date());
  const deliveryKey = "telegram_news_delivery:" + source.categoryId + ":" + date;
  let priorDelivery = null;
  try {
    priorDelivery = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?").bind(deliveryKey).first();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not read " + source.topic + " delivery status from D1:", error);
    return "skipped";
  }
  const priorStatus = String(priorDelivery?.value || "");
  if (priorStatus.startsWith("sent:") || priorStatus === "sending") return priorStatus.startsWith("sent:") ? "sent" : "sending";
  if (manualRetry && !priorStatus.startsWith("failed:")) return "not_failed";
  if (priorStatus.startsWith("failed:")) {
    const failedAt = Number(priorStatus.split(":")[1] || 0);
    if (!manualRetry && failedAt && Date.now() - failedAt < 15 * 60 * 1e3) return "cooldown";
  } else if (time !== await getConfiguredDeliveryTime(env)) {
    return "not_due";
  }
  try {
    if (!priorStatus) {
      const claim = await env.DB.prepare(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, 'sending')"
      ).bind(deliveryKey).run();
      if (Number(claim?.meta?.changes || 0) !== 1) return "claimed_elsewhere";
    } else if (priorStatus.startsWith("failed:")) {
      const claim = await env.DB.prepare(
        "UPDATE settings SET value = 'sending' WHERE key = ? AND value = ?"
      ).bind(deliveryKey, priorStatus).run();
      if (Number(claim?.meta?.changes || 0) !== 1) return "claimed_elsewhere";
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not claim " + source.topic + " delivery slot:", error);
    return "skipped";
  }
  let failureStage = "google_news_rss";
  try {
    const articles = await fetchGoogleNewsArticles(env, source.googleNewsUrl);
    failureStage = "gemini_summarization";
    const stories = await summarizeArticles(env.GEMINI_API_KEY, source.topic, articles);
    failureStage = "message_formatting";
    const message = buildNewsMessage(source.topic, stories, articles);
    failureStage = "telegram_send";
    const sentIds = await sendNewsMessage(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, telegramChannelId, message);
    await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE settings SET value = ? WHERE key = ?").bind("sent:" + sentIds.join(","), deliveryKey).run();
    console.log(source.topic + " daily news digest sent. Story count:", stories.length, "Message IDs:", sentIds.join(","));
    return "sent";
  } catch (error) {
    const rawMessage = String(error?.message || error || "Unknown error");
    const safeMessage = rawMessage.replace(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "__NO_TELEGRAM_TOKEN__", "[REDACTED]").replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 300);
    const failureRecord = "failed:" + Date.now() + ":" + failureStage + ":" + safeMessage;
    await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE settings SET value = ? WHERE key = ?").bind(failureRecord, deliveryKey).run().catch((dbError) => console.error("Could not record failed delivery:", dbError));
    console.error(source.topic + " daily news delivery failed at " + failureStage + ":", safeMessage);
    return "failed";
  }
}
__name(runCategoryNewsDelivery, "runCategoryNewsDelivery");
async function sendIndiaStartupsNewsTest(env, telegramChannelId) {
  if (!env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) throw new Error("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not configured.");
  if (!env.GEMINI_API_KEY) throw new Error("GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.");
  if (!telegramChannelId) throw new Error("The Startup Telegram channel ID is missing.");
  const articles = await fetchGoogleNewsArticles(env, INDIA_STARTUPS_SOURCE.googleNewsUrl);
  const stories = await summarizeArticles(env.GEMINI_API_KEY, INDIA_STARTUPS_SOURCE.topic, articles);
  const message = buildNewsMessage(INDIA_STARTUPS_SOURCE.topic + " \u2014 TEST DELIVERY", stories, articles);
  const messageIds = await sendNewsMessage(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, telegramChannelId, message);
  console.log("India Startups test digest sent. Story count:", stories.length, "Message IDs:", messageIds.join(","));
  return { storyCount: stories.length, messageIds };
}
__name(sendIndiaStartupsNewsTest, "sendIndiaStartupsNewsTest");
async function getConfiguredDeliveryTime(env) {
  try {
    const setting = await env.DB.prepare(
      "SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'news_delivery_time_ist'"
    ).first();
    const value = String(setting?.value || DEFAULT_NEWS_DELIVERY_TIME_IST);
    return /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(value) ? value : DEFAULT_NEWS_DELIVERY_TIME_IST;
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_NEWS_DELIVERY_TIME_IST;
  }
}
__name(getConfiguredDeliveryTime, "getConfiguredDeliveryTime");
function getIndiaDateAndTime(date) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(date);
  const values = {};
  for (const part of parts) values[part.type] = part.value;
  return {
    date: values.year + "-" + values.month + "-" + values.day,
    time: values.hour + ":" + values.minute
  };
}
__name(getIndiaDateAndTime, "getIndiaDateAndTime");
async function getGoogleNewsCooldownRemaining(env) {
  const setting = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?").bind(GOOGLE_NEWS_COOLDOWN_SETTING_KEY).first();
  const cooldownUntil = Number(setting?.value || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(cooldownUntil) || cooldownUntil <= Date.now()) return 0;
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((cooldownUntil - Date.now()) / 1e3));
}
__name(getGoogleNewsCooldownRemaining, "getGoogleNewsCooldownRemaining");
function parseRetryAfter(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const seconds = Number(value);
  if (Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds >= 0) return Math.ceil(seconds);
  const date = Date.parse(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date)) return null;
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((date - Date.now()) / 1e3));
}
__name(parseRetryAfter, "parseRetryAfter");
async function fetchGoogleNewsArticles(env, googleNewsUrl) {
  const cooldown = await getGoogleNewsCooldownRemaining(env);
  if (cooldown > 0) {
    throw new GoogleNewsRateLimitError(cooldown);
  }
  const requestHeaders = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8",
    "Accept-Language": "en-IN,en;q=0.9"
  };
  const maxAttempts = 3;
  const retryDelayMs = [2e3, 5e3];
  let response = null;
  let lastFetchError = null;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      const attemptResponse = await fetch(googleNewsUrl, {
        headers: requestHeaders,
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2e4)
      });
      if (attemptResponse.status === 429) {
        response = attemptResponse;
        break;
      }
      if (attemptResponse.status >= 500 && attemptResponse.status <= 599) {
        if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
          await attemptResponse.body?.cancel().catch(() => void 0);
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, retryDelayMs[attempt - 1]));
          continue;
        }
      }
      response = attemptResponse;
      break;
    } catch (error) {
      lastFetchError = error;
      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, retryDelayMs[attempt - 1]));
      }
    }
  }
  if (!response) {
    throw new Error(
      "Google News RSS request failed after " + maxAttempts + " attempts: " + String(lastFetchError instanceof Error ? lastFetchError.message : lastFetchError || "unknown network error")
    );
  }
  if (response.status === 429) {
    const retryAfterHeader = response.headers.get("Retry-After");
    const suppliedRetryAfter = parseRetryAfter(retryAfterHeader);
    const retryAfterSeconds = Math.min(
      Math.max(suppliedRetryAfter ?? GOOGLE_NEWS_DEFAULT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, 1),
      GOOGLE_NEWS_MAX_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
    );
    const diagnosticHeaders = {};
    for (const name of ["content-type", "server", "date", "retry-after", "via", "x-cache", "cf-ray"]) {
      const value = response.headers.get(name);
      if (value) diagnosticHeaders[name] = value.slice(0, 200);
    }
    let bodyPreview = "";
    try {
      bodyPreview = (await response.clone().text()).replace(/[\\r\\n\\t]+/g, " ").replace(/[\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f]/g, "").slice(0, 600);
    } catch {
      bodyPreview = "[response body could not be read]";
    }
    console.error("Google News RSS upstream error diagnostic:", JSON.stringify({
      status: response.status,
      statusText: response.statusText,
      headers: diagnosticHeaders,
      bodyPreview
    }));
    const cooldownUntil = Date.now() + retryAfterSeconds * 1e3;
    try {
      await env.DB.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)").bind(GOOGLE_NEWS_COOLDOWN_SETTING_KEY, String(cooldownUntil)).run();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Could not save Google News rate-limit cooldown in D1:", error);
    }
    await response.body?.cancel().catch(() => void 0);
    const retryDetail = "Google News returned HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests)." + (retryAfterHeader ? " Retry-After header: " + retryAfterHeader.slice(0, 200) + "." : " No Retry-After header was supplied.");
    throw new GoogleNewsRateLimitError(retryAfterSeconds, retryDetail);
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    if (response.status >= 500 && response.status <= 599) {
      const diagnosticHeaders = {};
      for (const name of ["content-type", "server", "date", "retry-after", "via", "x-cache", "cf-ray"]) {
        const value = response.headers.get(name);
        if (value) diagnosticHeaders[name] = value.slice(0, 200);
      }
      let bodyPreview = "";
      try {
        bodyPreview = (await response.clone().text()).replace(/[\\r\n\\t]+/g, " ").replace(/[\\u0000-\\u001f\\u007f]/g, "").slice(0, 600);
      } catch {
        bodyPreview = "[response body could not be read]";
      }
      console.error("Google News RSS upstream error diagnostic:", JSON.stringify({
        status: response.status,
        statusText: response.statusText,
        headers: diagnosticHeaders,
        bodyPreview
      }));
      const suppliedRetryAfter = parseRetryAfter(response.headers.get("Retry-After"));
      const cooldownSeconds = Math.min(
        Math.max(suppliedRetryAfter ?? 300, 60),
        GOOGLE_NEWS_MAX_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
      );
      const cooldownUntil = Date.now() + cooldownSeconds * 1e3;
      try {
        await env.DB.prepare("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)").bind(GOOGLE_NEWS_COOLDOWN_SETTING_KEY, String(cooldownUntil)).run();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Could not save Google News 5xx cooldown in D1:", error);
      }
      await response.body?.cancel().catch(() => void 0);
      throw new GoogleNewsRateLimitError(cooldownSeconds);
    }
    throw new Error("Google News RSS request failed with HTTP " + response.status + ".");
  }
  const xml = await response.text();
  if (!xml || xml.length < 100) {
    throw new Error("Google News returned an empty or incomplete RSS feed.");
  }
  const itemBlocks = xml.match(/<item\b[\s\S]*?<\/item>/gi) || [];
  const articles = [];
  const seenUrls = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const item of itemBlocks) {
    const title = htmlToText(readGoogleNewsRssField(item, "title"));
    const link = htmlToText(readGoogleNewsRssField(item, "link"));
    const url = safeHttpUrl(link);
    if (!title || title.length < 8 || !url || seenUrls.has(url)) continue;
    const description = htmlToText(readGoogleNewsRssField(item, "description")).slice(0, 1200);
    const sourceName = htmlToText(readGoogleNewsRssField(item, "source")) || "Google News";
    const dateText = htmlToText(readGoogleNewsRssField(item, "pubDate"));
    const parsedDate = dateText ? new Date(dateText) : /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
    const publishedAt = Number.isNaN(parsedDate.getTime()) ? /* @__PURE__ */ new Date() : parsedDate;
    seenUrls.add(url);
    articles.push({ title, url, description, source: sourceName, publishedAt });
    if (articles.length >= 40) break;
  }
  if (articles.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("Google News RSS feed loaded, but no usable headlines could be extracted.");
  }
  return articles;
}
__name(fetchGoogleNewsArticles, "fetchGoogleNewsArticles");
function readGoogleNewsRssField(item, tagName) {
  const match = item.match(
    new RegExp("<" + tagName + "\\b[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/" + tagName + "\\s*>", "i")
  );
  return match?.[1] || "";
}
__name(readGoogleNewsRssField, "readGoogleNewsRssField");
function htmlToText(value) {
  return decodeXmlText(value.replace(/<script\b[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, " ").replace(/<style\b[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, " ").replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ").replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}
__name(htmlToText, "htmlToText");
function decodeXmlText(value) {
  return value.replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g, "$1").replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_match, hex) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(hex, 16))).replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_match, decimal) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(decimal, 10))).replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/&lt;/g, "<").replace(/&gt;/g, ">").replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&apos;|&#39;/g, "'");
}
__name(decodeXmlText, "decodeXmlText");
function safeHttpUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}
__name(safeHttpUrl, "safeHttpUrl");
async function summarizeArticles(apiKey, categoryTopic, articles) {
  const articleInput = articles.map((article, index) => {
    const date = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", {
      timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric"
    }).format(article.publishedAt);
    return [
      "ARTICLE " + (index + 1),
      "Title: " + article.title,
      "Source: " + article.source,
      "Date: " + date,
      "Description: " + (article.description || "No description supplied.")
    ].join("\n");
  }).join("\n\n");
  const prompt = [
    "Prepare a concise daily " + categoryTopic + " news digest using only the supplied articles.",
    "Select exactly 10 useful, recent and genuinely relevant stories. If fewer than 10 supplied articles are genuinely relevant, do not invent or pad stories; return the relevant stories and the application will reject the digest instead of sending an incomplete test or daily delivery.",
    ...categoryTopic === "India Startups" ? [
      "Include only Indian startup ecosystem stories: startup companies, founders, venture capital, angel investment, funding rounds, startup launches, acquisitions, incubators, accelerators, or unicorns.",
      "Exclude general business, established-company, stock-market, banking, and economy stories unless they directly concern an Indian startup."
    ] : [],
    "Put constructive or positive developments first. If there is a genuine significant risk or setback, place it last.",
    "Use very simple English and short explanations. Do not use the words you or your.",
    "Do not invent facts, figures, quotes, dates, or details. Do not repeat a story.",
    "Return only one line per selected story in this exact format:",
    "STORY|ARTICLE_NUMBER|HEADLINE|ONE SHORT EXPLANATION",
    "ARTICLE_NUMBER must be the number of the supplied article. Do not include source links; they will be added separately.",
    "",
    articleInput
  ].join("\n");
  let response = null;
  let lastGeminiError = null;
  const geminiRetryDelays = [2e3, 5e3];
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
    try {
      const attemptResponse = await fetch(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/" + GEMINI_MODEL + ":generateContent?key=" + encodeURIComponent(apiKey),
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
            generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 2600 }
          }),
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25e3)
        }
      );
      if ((attemptResponse.status === 429 || attemptResponse.status >= 500 && attemptResponse.status <= 599) && attempt < 3) {
        await attemptResponse.body?.cancel().catch(() => void 0);
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, geminiRetryDelays[attempt - 1]));
        continue;
      }
      response = attemptResponse;
      break;
    } catch (error) {
      lastGeminiError = error;
      if (attempt < 3) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, geminiRetryDelays[attempt - 1]));
      }
    }
  }
  if (!response) {
    throw new Error(
      "Gemini request failed after 3 attempts: " + String(lastGeminiError instanceof Error ? lastGeminiError.message : lastGeminiError || "unknown network error")
    );
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Gemini request failed with HTTP " + response.status + ".");
  }
  const result = await response.json();
  const generatedText = (result?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || []).map((part) => part.text || "").join("\n").replace(new RegExp(String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3) + "[a-z]*|" + String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3), "gi"), "").trim();
  const stories = [];
  const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const line of generatedText.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const match = line.trim().match(/^STORY\|(\d+)\|([^|]+)\|(.+)$/i);
    if (!match) continue;
    const articleNumber = Number(match[1]);
    if (articleNumber < 1 || articleNumber > articles.length || seen.has(articleNumber)) continue;
    seen.add(articleNumber);
    stories.push({
      articleNumber,
      headline: match[2].trim(),
      explanation: match[3].trim()
    });
    if (stories.length >= 10) break;
  }
  if (stories.length !== 10) {
    throw new Error("Category digest requires exactly 10 distinct relevant stories; Gemini returned " + stories.length + ". Nothing was sent.");
  }
  return stories;
}
__name(summarizeArticles, "summarizeArticles");
function buildNewsMessage(categoryTitle, stories, articles) {
  if (stories.length !== 10) {
    throw new Error("The digest must contain exactly 10 stories. Nothing was sent.");
  }
  const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric"
  }).format(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date());
  const prepared = stories.map((story, index) => {
    const article = articles[story.articleNumber - 1];
    if (!article) {
      throw new Error("A source article is missing for story " + (index + 1) + ". Nothing was sent.");
    }
    const sourceDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", {
      timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric"
    }).format(article.publishedAt);
    return {
      headline: story.headline,
      explanation: story.explanation,
      sourceLine: '<a href="' + escapeTelegramHtml(article.url) + '">Source: ' + escapeTelegramHtml(article.source) + " \xB7 " + escapeTelegramHtml(sourceDate) + "</a>"
    };
  });
  const render = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => {
    let output = "<b>" + escapeTelegramHtml(categoryTitle) + " \u2014 Daily News</b>\n<code>" + escapeTelegramHtml(today) + "</code>\n\n";
    for (let index = 0; index < prepared.length; index++) {
      const item = prepared[index];
      output += "<b>" + (index + 1) + ". " + escapeTelegramHtml(item.headline) + "</b>\n" + escapeTelegramHtml(item.explanation) + "\n" + item.sourceLine + "\n\n";
    }
    return output.trim();
  }, "render");
  let message = render();
  let explanationIndex = 0;
  while (Array.from(message).length > 4096 && explanationIndex < prepared.length * 40) {
    const item = prepared[explanationIndex % prepared.length];
    const chars = Array.from(item.explanation);
    if (chars.length > 35) {
      item.explanation = chars.slice(0, Math.max(35, chars.length - 12)).join("").replace(/[\s,;:.!?-]+$/, "") + "\u2026";
    }
    explanationIndex++;
    message = render();
    if (prepared.every((entry) => Array.from(entry.explanation).length <= 36)) break;
  }
  let headlineIndex = 0;
  while (Array.from(message).length > 4096 && headlineIndex < prepared.length * 30) {
    const item = prepared[headlineIndex % prepared.length];
    const chars = Array.from(item.headline);
    if (chars.length > 35) {
      item.headline = chars.slice(0, Math.max(35, chars.length - 8)).join("").replace(/[\s,;:.!?-]+$/, "") + "\u2026";
    }
    headlineIndex++;
    message = render();
    if (prepared.every((entry) => Array.from(entry.headline).length <= 36)) break;
  }
  if (Array.from(message).length > 4096) {
    throw new Error("The 10 stories and their source links still exceed Telegram's 4,096-character limit after shortening. Nothing was sent.");
  }
  return message;
}
__name(buildNewsMessage, "buildNewsMessage");

  return value.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

async function sendTelegramChannelMessage(botToken, channelId, text) {
  const response = await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot" + botToken + "/sendMessage", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      chat_id: channelId,
      text,
      parse_mode: "HTML",
      disable_web_page_preview: true
    })
  });
  const result = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok || !result?.ok || !result?.result?.message_id) {
    throw new Error("Telegram sendMessage failed: " + (result?.description || response.status));
  }
  return { message_id: Number(result.result.message_id) };
}

var PASSWORD_ITERATIONS = 1e5;
var SESSION_DAYS = 30;

function base64url(bytes) {
  let binary = "";
  for (const byte of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);
  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/g, "");
}
__name(base64url, "base64url");
function fromBase64url(value) {
  const base64 = value.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
  const padded = base64 + "=".repeat((4 - base64.length % 4) % 4);
  const binary = atob(padded);
  return Uint8Array.from(binary, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
}
__name(fromBase64url, "fromBase64url");
async function sha256(value) {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(value)
  );
  return base64url(new Uint8Array(digest));
}
__name(sha256, "sha256");
async function hashPassword(password) {
  const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    new TextEncoder().encode(password),
    "PBKDF2",
    false,
    ["deriveBits"]
  );
  const bits = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits({
    name: "PBKDF2",
    salt,
    iterations: PASSWORD_ITERATIONS,
    hash: "SHA-256"
  }, key, 256);
  return `pbkdf2$${PASSWORD_ITERATIONS}$${base64url(salt)}$${base64url(new Uint8Array(bits))}`;
}
__name(hashPassword, "hashPassword");
async function verifyPassword(password, stored) {
  if (!stored || !stored.startsWith("pbkdf2$")) {
    return {
      valid: stored === password,
      needsUpgrade: stored === password
    };
  }
  try {
    const parts = stored.split("$");
    if (parts.length !== 4) return { valid: false, needsUpgrade: false };
    const iterations = Number(parts[1]);
    if (!Number.isInteger(iterations) || iterations < 1e5 || iterations > 1e6) {
      return { valid: false, needsUpgrade: false };
    }
    const salt = fromBase64url(parts[2]);
    const expected = fromBase64url(parts[3]);
    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      "raw",
      new TextEncoder().encode(password),
      "PBKDF2",
      false,
      ["deriveBits"]
    );
    const bits = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits({
      name: "PBKDF2",
      salt,
      iterations,
      hash: "SHA-256"
    }, key, 256);
    const actual = new Uint8Array(bits);
    if (actual.length !== expected.length) {
      return { valid: false, needsUpgrade: false };
    }
    let difference = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < actual.length; i++) {
      difference |= actual[i] ^ expected[i];
    }
    return { valid: difference === 0, needsUpgrade: false };
  } catch {
    return { valid: false, needsUpgrade: false };
  }
}
__name(verifyPassword, "verifyPassword");
async function createSession(env, userId) {
  const random = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
  const token = base64url(random);
  const tokenHash = await sha256(token);
  const expiresAt = new Date(
    Date.now() + SESSION_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1e3
  ).toISOString();
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO auth_sessions (user_id, token_hash, expires_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?)
  `).bind(userId, tokenHash, expiresAt).run();
  return token;
}
__name(createSession, "createSession");
function getBearerToken(request) {
  const header = request.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
  const match = header.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);
  return match ? match[1].trim() : null;
}

async function getAuthenticatedUser(request, env) {

  if (!token) return null;

  const now = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString();

    SELECT
      u.id,
      u.first_name,
      u.surname,
      u.email,
      u.country_code,
      u.mobile_number,
      u.category,

      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM telegram_connections tc WHERE tc.user_id = u.id
      ) AS telegram_connected,
      (

        WHERE tc.user_id = u.id LIMIT 1
      ) AS telegram_username
    FROM auth_sessions s

      AND s.expires_at > ?

  `).bind(tokenHash, now).first();

    return result;
  }

    FROM admin_google_sessions

    LIMIT 1
  `).bind(tokenHash, now).first();

    id: "google-admin",

    surname: "Kapuria",
    email: ADMIN_EMAIL,
    country_code: "+91",
    mobile_number: "",
    category: "",
    trial_expires_at: "",
    status: "active",
    role: "admin",
    created_at: adminSession.created_at || now,
    telegram_connected: 0,
    telegram_username: ""
  };
}

function publicUser(user) {
  const category = user.category || "";
  const trialExpiry = user.trial_expires_at || "";
  let subscriptionStatus = user.status || "trial";
  if (subscriptionStatus === "active") {
    subscriptionStatus = "active_paid";
  }
  return {
    id: String(user.id),
    name: `${user.first_name || ""} ${user.surname || ""}`.trim(),
    firstName: user.first_name || "",
    surname: user.surname || "",
    email: user.email,
    countryCode: user.country_code || "+91",
    mobileNumber: user.mobile_number || "",
    mobile: `${user.country_code || "+91"}${user.mobile_number || ""}`,
    role: user.role === "admin" ? "admin" : "customer",
    category,
    categories: category ? [category] : [],
    trialStart: user.created_at || "",
    trialExpiry,
    trialExpiresAt: trialExpiry,
    subscriptionStatus,
    paymentStatus: "none",
    telegramConnected: Boolean(user.telegram_connected),
    telegramUsername: user.telegram_username || "",
    createdAt: user.created_at || ""
  };
}

function roundMoney(value) {
  return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
}
__name(roundMoney, "roundMoney");
async function getPricingSettings(env) {
  const result = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT setting_key, setting_value
    FROM system_settings
    WHERE setting_key IN ('monthly_price', 'gst_rate')
  `).all();
  const values = {};
  for (const row of result.results || []) {
    values[row.setting_key] = row.setting_value;
  }
  const monthlyPrice = Number(values.monthly_price);
  const gstRate = Number(values.gst_rate);
  if (!Number.isFinite(monthlyPrice) || monthlyPrice <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(gstRate) || gstRate < 0 || gstRate > 100) {
    throw new Error("Monthly price or GST rate is missing or invalid in system_settings.");
  }
  const annualBasePrice = roundMoney(monthlyPrice * 12);
  const gstAmount = roundMoney(annualBasePrice * gstRate / 100);
  const totalAmount = roundMoney(annualBasePrice + gstAmount);
  return {
    monthlyPrice,
    annualBasePrice,
    gstRate,
    gstAmount,
    totalAmount
  };
}
__name(getPricingSettings, "getPricingSettings");

async function sendTelegramMessage(token, chatId, message, replyMarkup = null) {
  if (!token || !chatId) {
    console.error("Telegram sendMessage skipped: bot token or chat ID is missing.");
    return false;
  }
  const body = {
    chat_id: chatId,
    text: message,
    parse_mode: "Markdown"
  };
  if (replyMarkup) body.reply_markup = replyMarkup;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!response.ok || result.ok !== true) {
      console.error("Telegram sendMessage rejected:", {
        httpStatus: response.status,
        description: result.description || "Telegram returned an unsuccessful response."
      });
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Telegram sendMessage network failure:", String(error));
    return false;
  }
}
__name(sendTelegramMessage, "sendTelegramMessage");
async function ensureTelegramTables(env) {
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_verification_tokens (
      token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `).run();
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_connections (
      user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      telegram_chat_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      telegram_username TEXT,
      connected_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `).run();
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_telegram_notification_log (
      notification_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      notification_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sending',
      sent_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `).run();
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_subscription_periods (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `).run();
}

async function sendCustomerTelegramNotification(env, userId, notificationKey, notificationType, message) {
  const connection = await env.DB.prepare(
    "SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM telegram_connections WHERE user_id = ? LIMIT 1"
  ).bind(userId).first();
  if (!connection?.telegram_chat_id) {
    console.log("Customer Telegram notification skipped: customer is not connected.", String(userId), notificationType);
    return false;
  }
  const now = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString();
  const inserted = await env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO customer_telegram_notification_log
      (notification_key, user_id, notification_type, status, updated_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'sending', ?)
  `).bind(notificationKey, userId, notificationType, now).run();
  if (Number(inserted?.meta?.changes || 0) !== 1) {
    const prior = await env.DB.prepare(
      "SELECT status, updated_at FROM customer_telegram_notification_log WHERE notification_key = ?"
    ).bind(notificationKey).first();
    const staleSending = prior?.status === "sending" && Date.now() - Date.parse(String(prior.updated_at || "")) > 15 * 60 * 1e3;
    if (prior?.status !== "failed" && !staleSending) return false;
    const retry = await env.DB.prepare(`
      UPDATE customer_telegram_notification_log
      SET status = 'sending', updated_at = ?
      WHERE notification_key = ? AND (status = 'failed' OR (status = 'sending' AND updated_at = ?))
    `).bind(now, notificationKey, prior.updated_at).run();
    if (Number(retry?.meta?.changes || 0) !== 1) return false;
  }
  const sent = await sendTelegramMessage(
    env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
    connection.telegram_chat_id,
    message
  );
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    UPDATE customer_telegram_notification_log
    SET status = ?, sent_at = ?, updated_at = ?
    WHERE notification_key = ?
  `).bind(
    sent ? "sent" : "failed",
    sent ? (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString() : null,
    (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(),
    notificationKey
  ).run();
  return sent;
}
__name(sendCustomerTelegramNotification, "sendCustomerTelegramNotification");
function getIndiaDateKey(date) {
  const parts = getIndiaDateTimeParts(date);
  return parts.year + "-" + parts.month + "-" + parts.day;
}
__name(getIndiaDateKey, "getIndiaDateKey");
function addDaysToDateKey(dateKey, days) {
  const [year, month, day] = String(dateKey).split("-").map(Number);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days);
  return date.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
}
__name(addDaysToDateKey, "addDaysToDateKey");
function formatIndiaDate(date) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-IN", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric"
  }).format(date);
}
__name(formatIndiaDate, "formatIndiaDate");
async function sendScheduledCustomerReminders(env) {
  await ensureTelegramTables(env);
  const today = getIndiaDateKey(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date());
  const trials = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT id, first_name, trial_expires_at
    FROM users
    WHERE role = 'customer' AND status = 'trial' AND trial_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM payments p
        WHERE p.user_id = users.id AND p.status = 'pending'
      )
  `).all();
  for (const user of trials.results || []) {
    const expiryDate = new Date(user.trial_expires_at);
    if (Number.isNaN(expiryDate.getTime()) || getIndiaDateKey(expiryDate) !== today) continue;
    await sendCustomerTelegramNotification(
      env,
      user.id,
      "trial-payment-reminder:" + user.id + ":" + today,
      "trial_payment_reminder",
      "\u23F0 *Your MyDigitAsset free trial ends today.*\n\nTo continue receiving your selected category's daily news in its Telegram channel, please complete the annual subscription payment from the MyDigitAsset dashboard.\n\nOpen: https://mydigitasset.com/\n\nDaily news and promotional messages are posted in category channels only. Account and payment updates are sent here."
    );
  }
  const periods = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT user_id, MAX(expires_at) AS expires_at
    FROM customer_subscription_periods
    GROUP BY user_id
  `).all();
  for (const period of periods.results || []) {
    const expiryDate = new Date(period.expires_at);
    if (Number.isNaN(expiryDate.getTime())) continue;
    const renewalNoticeDate = addDaysToDateKey(getIndiaDateKey(expiryDate), -7);
    if (renewalNoticeDate !== today) continue;
    await sendCustomerTelegramNotification(
      env,
      period.user_id,
      "subscription-renewal:" + period.user_id + ":" + String(period.expires_at),
      "subscription_renewal",
      "\u{1F514} *Your MyDigitAsset annual subscription is due for renewal in 7 days.*\n\nCurrent access ends on *" + formatIndiaDate(expiryDate) + "* . To avoid interruption, please renew from the MyDigitAsset dashboard.\n\nOpen: https://mydigitasset.com/\n\nDaily news and promotional messages continue to appear in category channels only."
    );
  }
}
__name(sendScheduledCustomerReminders, "sendScheduledCustomerReminders");
async function configureTelegramWebhook(env) {
  const token = String(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "");
  const secret = String(env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET || "");
  if (!token || !secret) {
    throw new Error("Telegram bot token or webhook secret is not configured.");
  }
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$/.test(secret)) {
    throw new Error("Telegram webhook secret must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.");
  }
  const response = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/setWebhook`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      url: "https://mydigitasset.com/api/telegram/webhook",
      secret_token: secret,
      allowed_updates: ["message", "callback_query"],
      drop_pending_updates: false
    })
  });
  const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok || result.ok !== true) {
    console.error("Telegram setWebhook rejected:", {
      httpStatus: response.status,
      description: result.description || "Telegram returned an unsuccessful response."
    });
    throw new Error(result.description || "Telegram could not register the MyDigitAsset webhook.");
  }
  return true;
}
__name(configureTelegramWebhook, "configureTelegramWebhook");
async function hasDatabaseColumn(env, tableName, columnName) {
  const allowedTables = ["payments", "user_subscriptions", "categories"];
  if (!allowedTables.includes(tableName)) return false;
  const result = await env.DB.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(" + tableName + ")").all();
  return (result.results || []).some((column) => column.name === columnName);
}
__name(hasDatabaseColumn, "hasDatabaseColumn");
function randomId(prefix) {
  return prefix + "_" + base64url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(18)));
}
__name(randomId, "randomId");
function getIndiaDateTimeParts(date = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(date);
  const values = {};
  for (const part of parts) values[part.type] = part.value;
  return values;
}
__name(getIndiaDateTimeParts, "getIndiaDateTimeParts");
function nextPromotionDate(date = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
  const p = getIndiaDateTimeParts(date);
  let year = Number(p.year);
  let month = Number(p.month);
  const day = Number(p.day);
  const time = p.hour + ":" + p.minute;
  let targetDay;
  if (day < 14 || day === 14 && time < "06:15") {
    targetDay = 14;
  } else if (day < 28 || day === 28 && time < "06:15") {
    targetDay = 28;
  } else {
    targetDay = 14;
    month += 1;
    if (month > 12) {
      month = 1;
      year += 1;
    }
  }
  return String(year).padStart(4, "0") + "-" + String(month).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(targetDay).padStart(2, "0");
}
__name(nextPromotionDate, "nextPromotionDate");
function makeAffiliateDestination(rawUrl, parameterName, trackingCode) {
  try {
    const destination = new URL(String(rawUrl || ""));
    const parameter = String(parameterName || "").trim();
    if (parameter) destination.searchParams.set(parameter, trackingCode);
    return destination.toString();
  } catch {
    return String(rawUrl || "");
  }
}
__name(makeAffiliateDestination, "makeAffiliateDestination");
async function sendPromotionToChannel(env, campaign, channel, delivery) {
  const token = String(env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN || "");
  if (!token) throw new Error("Telegram bot token is not configured.");
  const trackedUrl = "https://mydigitasset.com/api/affiliate/click?code=" + encodeURIComponent(delivery.tracking_code);
  const text = [campaign.message_text || "", campaign.affiliate_disclosure || ""].filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  const replyMarkup = campaign.affiliate_url ? {
    inline_keyboard: [[{
      text: campaign.link_label || "View Offer",
      url: trackedUrl
    }]]
  } : void 0;
  const imageUrl = String(campaign.image_url || "").trim();
  let endpoint;
  let payload;
  if (imageUrl) {
    endpoint = "sendPhoto";
    payload = {
      chat_id: channel.telegram_chat_id,
      photo: imageUrl,
      caption: text.slice(0, 1024),
      ...replyMarkup ? { reply_markup: replyMarkup } : {}
    };
  } else {
    endpoint = "sendMessage";
    payload = {
      chat_id: channel.telegram_chat_id,
      text: text.slice(0, 4096),
      disable_web_page_preview: false,
      ...replyMarkup ? { reply_markup: replyMarkup } : {}
    };
  }
  const response = await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot" + token + "/" + endpoint, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });
  const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok || result.ok !== true) {
    throw new Error(String(result.description || "Telegram rejected the promotional message."));
  }
  return String(result.result?.message_id || "");
}
__name(sendPromotionToChannel, "sendPromotionToChannel");
async function ensurePromotionTargetTable(env) {
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promo_campaign_targets (
      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, category_id)
    )
  `).run();
}
__name(ensurePromotionTargetTable, "ensurePromotionTargetTable");
async function savePromotionTargets(env, campaignId, targetCategoryIds) {
  await ensurePromotionTargetTable(env);
  const requested = Array.isArray(targetCategoryIds) ? [...new Set(targetCategoryIds.map((value) => String(value || "").trim()).filter(Boolean))] : [];
  const valid = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT id FROM managed_categories
    WHERE active = 1 AND telegram_chat_id <> ''
  `).all();
  const allowed = new Set((valid.results || []).map((row) => String(row.id)));
  const selected = requested.filter((id) => allowed.has(id));
  if (!selected.length) throw new Error("Select at least one active Telegram channel.");
  await env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM promo_campaign_targets WHERE campaign_id = ?").bind(campaignId).run();
  for (const categoryId of selected) {
    await env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO promo_campaign_targets (campaign_id, category_id)
      VALUES (?, ?)
    `).bind(campaignId, categoryId).run();
  }
  return selected;
}
__name(savePromotionTargets, "savePromotionTargets");
async function getPromotionChannels(env, campaignId) {
  await ensurePromotionTargetTable(env);
  const targets = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT mc.id, mc.title, mc.telegram_chat_id
    FROM promo_campaign_targets t
    JOIN managed_categories mc ON mc.id = t.category_id
    WHERE t.campaign_id = ? AND mc.active = 1 AND mc.telegram_chat_id <> ''
    ORDER BY mc.display_order, mc.title
  `).bind(campaignId).all();
  if ((targets.results || []).length) return targets.results;
  const all = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT id, title, telegram_chat_id
    FROM managed_categories
    WHERE active = 1 AND telegram_chat_id <> ''
    ORDER BY display_order, title
  `).all();
  return all.results || [];
}
__name(getPromotionChannels, "getPromotionChannels");
async function deliverPromotionCampaign(env, campaign, channels, expectedTotal = channels.length) {
  const results = [];
  for (const channel of channels) {
    const chatId = String(channel.telegram_chat_id);
    let delivery = await env.DB.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM promo_deliveries
      WHERE campaign_id = ? AND channel_id = ? LIMIT 1
    `).bind(campaign.id, chatId).first();
    if (delivery?.status === "sent") {
      results.push({ channelId: chatId, channelName: channel.title, status: "sent", skipped: true });
      continue;
    }
    if (!delivery) {
      const trackingCode2 = base64url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24)));
      const deliveryId = randomId("pd");
      await env.DB.prepare(`
        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO promo_deliveries
          (id, campaign_id, channel_id, channel_name, status, tracking_code, attempts)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, 0)
      `).bind(deliveryId, campaign.id, chatId, channel.title, trackingCode2).run();
      delivery = await env.DB.prepare(`
        SELECT * FROM promo_deliveries
        WHERE campaign_id = ? AND channel_id = ? LIMIT 1
      `).bind(campaign.id, chatId).first();
    }
    let trackingCode = String(delivery?.tracking_code || "");
    if (!trackingCode) {
      trackingCode = base64url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24)));
      await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE promo_deliveries SET tracking_code = ? WHERE id = ?").bind(trackingCode, delivery.id).run();
    }
    await env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO affiliate_tracking_links
        (tracking_code, campaign_id, product_name, source_type, source_id, outbound_url, created_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'telegram', ?, ?, ?)
    `).bind(
      trackingCode,
      campaign.id,
      campaign.product_name || campaign.campaign_name,
      String(channel.id),
      makeAffiliateDestination(campaign.affiliate_url, campaign.tracking_parameter, trackingCode),
      (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()
    ).run();
    try {
      if (!campaign.affiliate_url) throw new Error("Campaign has no affiliate destination URL.");
      const messageId = await sendPromotionToChannel(env, campaign, channel, { ...delivery, tracking_code: trackingCode });
      await env.DB.prepare(`
        UPDATE promo_deliveries
        SET status = 'sent', telegram_message_id = ?, error_message = NULL,
            attempts = attempts + 1, delivered_at = ?, updated_at = ?
        WHERE id = ?
      `).bind(messageId, (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), delivery.id).run();
      results.push({ channelId: chatId, channelName: channel.title, status: "sent", messageId });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = String(error?.message || error).slice(0, 500);
      await env.DB.prepare(`
        UPDATE promo_deliveries
        SET status = 'failed', error_message = ?, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = ?
        WHERE id = ?
      `).bind(message, (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), delivery.id).run();
      results.push({ channelId: chatId, channelName: channel.title, status: "failed", error: message });
      console.error("Promotion delivery failed for channel " + channel.title + ":", message);
    }
  }
  const counts = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sent,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed
    FROM promo_deliveries WHERE campaign_id = ?
  `).bind(campaign.id).first();
  const allSent = Number(expectedTotal) > 0 && Number(counts?.total || 0) >= Number(expectedTotal) && Number(counts?.sent || 0) === Number(expectedTotal);
  if (allSent) {
    await env.DB.prepare(`
      UPDATE promo_campaigns SET status = 'sent', sent_at = ?, updated_at = ?
      WHERE id = ?
    `).bind((/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString(), campaign.id).run();
  }
  return {
    total: channels.length,
    sent: results.filter((row) => row.status === "sent").length,
    failed: results.filter((row) => row.status === "failed").length,
    allSent,
    results
  };
}
__name(deliverPromotionCampaign, "deliverPromotionCampaign");
async function runDuePromotionCampaignsForChannel(env, channel) {
  const parts = getIndiaDateTimeParts();
  if (parts.day !== "14" && parts.day !== "28") return;
  const today = parts.year + "-" + parts.month + "-" + parts.day;
  const campaigns = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM promo_campaigns
    WHERE status = 'approved' AND scheduled_for = ?
    ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  `).bind(today).all();
  for (const campaign of campaigns.results || []) {
    const selectedChannels = await getPromotionChannels(env, campaign.id);
    const isTargeted = selectedChannels.some(
      (item) => String(item.id) === String(channel.id) && String(item.telegram_chat_id) === String(channel.telegram_chat_id)
    );
    if (!isTargeted) continue;
    await deliverPromotionCampaign(env, campaign, [channel], selectedChannels.length);
  }
}
__name(runDuePromotionCampaignsForChannel, "runDuePromotionCampaignsForChannel");

      if (url.pathname === "/api/admin/promotions/upload-image" && method === "POST") {
        const admin = await getAuthorizedAdmin(request, env);
        if (!admin) return json({ error: "Administrator access required." }, 403);
        if (!env.AD_IMAGES) return json({ error: "Promotional image storage is not configured." }, 503);
        const formData = await request.formData();
        const file = formData.get("image");
        if (!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer !== "function") {
          return json({ error: "Please select an image file." }, 400);
        }
        if (file.size <= 0 || file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
          return json({ error: "Image must be no larger than 5 MB." }, 400);
        }
        const mime = String(file.type || "").toLowerCase();
        const extensions = { "image/jpeg": "jpg", "image/png": "png", "image/webp": "webp" };
        const extension = extensions[mime];
        if (!extension) {
          return json({ error: "Only JPG, PNG and WebP images are supported." }, 415);
        }
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
        const isJpeg = mime === "image/jpeg" && bytes[0] === 255 && bytes[1] === 216 && bytes[2] === 255;
        const isPng = mime === "image/png" && bytes.length >= 8 && bytes[0] === 137 && bytes[1] === 80 && bytes[2] === 78 && bytes[3] === 71 && bytes[4] === 13 && bytes[5] === 10 && bytes[6] === 26 && bytes[7] === 10;
        const isWebp = mime === "image/webp" && bytes.length >= 12 && String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(0, 4)) === "RIFF" && String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(8, 12)) === "WEBP";
        if (!(isJpeg || isPng || isWebp)) {
          return json({ error: "The selected file does not appear to be a valid JPG, PNG or WebP image." }, 400);
        }
        const objectKey = randomId("img") + "." + extension;
        await env.AD_IMAGES.put(objectKey, bytes, {
          httpMetadata: {
            contentType: mime,
            cacheControl: "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
          }
        });
        const imageUrl = new URL("/api/promo-images/" + objectKey, url.origin).toString();
        return json({ success: true, imageUrl });

        const authenticatedUser = await getAuthenticatedUser(request, env);
        if (!authenticatedUser || Number(authenticatedUser.id) !== userId) {
          return json({ error: "Please sign in to submit your payment reference." }, 401);
        }
        const user = await env.DB.prepare(`
          SELECT first_name, surname, email, mobile_number, category
          FROM users WHERE id = ?
        `).bind(userId).first();
        if (!user) {
          return json({ error: "Customer account not found." }, 404);
        }
        const pricing = await getPricingSettings(env);
        const paymentAmount = pricing.totalAmount;
        await env.DB.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO payments (user_id, amount, utr_number, status)
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'pending')
        `).bind(userId, paymentAmount, utrNumber).run();
        const selectedCategory = CATEGORIES.find(
          (item) => item.id === user.category
        );
        const categoryTitle = selectedCategory ? selectedCategory.title : user.category;
        const keyboard = {
          inline_keyboard: [[
            { text: "\u2705 Approve", callback_data: `APPROVE_${userId}` },
            { text: "\u274C Stop", callback_data: `STOP_${userId}` }
          ]]
        };
        await sendTelegramMessage(
          env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
          env.OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID,
          `\u{1F4B3} *Annual Subscription Payment Submitted!*

*User ID:* #${userId}
*Name:* ${user.first_name || ""} ${user.surname || ""}
*Mobile:* ${user.mobile_number || ""}
*Email:* ${user.email}
*Category:* ${categoryTitle}
*Annual Base Price:* \u20B9${pricing.annualBasePrice.toFixed(2)}
*GST (${pricing.gstRate}%):* \u20B9${pricing.gstAmount.toFixed(2)}
*Total Amount:* \u20B9${paymentAmount.toFixed(2)}
*UTR / Reference No:* \`${utrNumber}\``,
          keyboard
        );
        return json({
          success: true,
          amount: paymentAmount,
          message: "Payment reference submitted successfully for verification."
        });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/telegram/webhook" && method === "POST") {
        const configuredSecret = String(env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET || "");
        const receivedSecret = request.headers.get("X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token") || "";
        if (!configuredSecret || receivedSecret !== configuredSecret) {
          return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
        }
        const update = await parseRequestBody(request);
        if (update.message) {
          const message = update.message;
          const chat = message.chat || {};
          const from = message.from || {};
          const messageText = String(message.text || "").trim();
          if (chat.type === "private" && messageText.startsWith("/verify")) {
            const match = messageText.match(/^\/verify(?:@\w+)?\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})$/);
            if (!match) {
              await sendTelegramMessage(
                env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
                chat.id,
                "Please send the complete one-time command copied from the MyDigitAsset website."
              );
              return json({ ok: true });
            }
            const verificationToken = match[1];
            const tokenRow = await env.DB.prepare(`
              SELECT user_id FROM telegram_verification_tokens
              WHERE token = ? AND used = 0 AND expires_at > ?
              LIMIT 1
            `).bind(verificationToken, (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()).first();
            if (!tokenRow) {
              await sendTelegramMessage(
                env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
                chat.id,
                "This verification code is invalid, already used, or expired. Please generate a new code on the MyDigitAsset website."
              );
              return json({ ok: true });
            }
            const telegramUsername = from.username ? `@${String(from.username).replace(/^@/, "")}` : String(from.first_name || "Telegram user");
            await env.DB.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO telegram_connections (
                user_id, telegram_chat_id, telegram_username, connected_at
              )
              VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
              ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
                telegram_chat_id = excluded.telegram_chat_id,
                telegram_username = excluded.telegram_username,
                connected_at = excluded.connected_at
            `).bind(
              tokenRow.user_id,
              String(chat.id),
              telegramUsername,
              (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString()
            ).run();
            await env.DB.prepare(`
              UPDATE telegram_verification_tokens SET used = 1
              WHERE token = ? AND used = 0
            `).bind(verificationToken).run();
            await sendTelegramMessage(
              env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
              chat.id,
              "\u2705 Your Telegram account is now securely connected to MyDigitAsset. You can return to the website."
            );
            await sendCustomerTelegramNotification(
              env,
              tokenRow.user_id,
              "welcome:" + tokenRow.user_id,
              "welcome",
              "\u{1F389} *Welcome to MyDigitAsset!*\n\nYour Telegram account is connected. Daily news digests and promotional offers will be posted in your selected category Telegram channel. Welcome, payment confirmation, payment reminders and subscription renewal notices will be sent privately here.\n\nVisit https://mydigitasset.com/ to manage your subscription."
            );
            console.log("Telegram customer verification completed for user:", String(tokenRow.user_id));
            return json({ ok: true });
          }
          return json({ ok: true });
        }
        if (update.callback_query) {
          const callback = update.callback_query;
          const callbackData = String(callback.data || "");
          const chatId = callback.message?.chat?.id;
          const expectedChatId = String(env.OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID || "");
          if (!expectedChatId || String(chatId ?? "") !== expectedChatId) {
            return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 403);
          }
          try {
            const acknowledgement = await fetch(
              `https://api.telegram.org/bot${env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/answerCallbackQuery`,
              {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({ callback_query_id: callback.id })
              }
            );
            const acknowledgementResult = await acknowledgement.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!acknowledgement.ok || acknowledgementResult.ok !== true) {
              console.warn("Telegram callback acknowledgement was not accepted:", {
                httpStatus: acknowledgement.status,
                description: acknowledgementResult.description || "Unknown Telegram response"
              });
            }
          } catch (acknowledgementError) {
            console.warn("Telegram callback acknowledgement failed:", String(acknowledgementError));
          }
          const match = callbackData.match(/^(APPROVE|STOP)_(\d+)$/);
          if (match) {
            const action = match[1];
            const userId = Number(match[2]);
            if (action === "APPROVE") {
              const customer = await env.DB.prepare(
                "SELECT first_name, surname FROM users WHERE id = ? AND role = 'customer' LIMIT 1"
              ).bind(userId).first();
              const approvedPayment = await env.DB.prepare(
                "UPDATE payments SET status = 'approved' WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'pending'"
              ).bind(userId).run();
              if (customer && Number(approvedPayment?.meta?.changes || 0) > 0) {
                const now = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
                const currentPeriod = await env.DB.prepare(
                  "SELECT MAX(expires_at) AS expires_at FROM customer_subscription_periods WHERE user_id = ?"
                ).bind(userId).first();
                const existingExpiry = currentPeriod?.expires_at ? new Date(currentPeriod.expires_at) : null;
                const periodStart = existingExpiry && existingExpiry > now ? existingExpiry : now;
                const periodEnd = new Date(periodStart);
                periodEnd.setUTCFullYear(periodEnd.getUTCFullYear() + 1);
                const startedAt = periodStart.toISOString();
                const expiresAt = periodEnd.toISOString();
                await env.DB.prepare(
                  "INSERT INTO customer_subscription_periods (user_id, started_at, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
                ).bind(userId, startedAt, expiresAt).run();
                await env.DB.prepare(
                  "UPDATE users SET status = 'active' WHERE id = ?"
                ).bind(userId).run();
                await sendCustomerTelegramNotification(
                  env,
                  userId,
                  "payment-confirmation:" + userId + ":" + expiresAt,
                  "payment_confirmation",
                  "\u2705 *Your MyDigitAsset payment has been confirmed!*\n\nThank you. Your annual subscription is now active until *" + formatIndiaDate(periodEnd) + "* .\n\nDaily news digests and promotional offers will be posted in your selected category Telegram channel. Your account and payment notices will be sent privately here.\n\nOpen: https://mydigitasset.com/"
                );
              }
              await sendTelegramMessage(
                env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
                chatId,
                Number(approvedPayment?.meta?.changes || 0) > 0 ? `\u2705 Payment for customer #${userId} has been approved and the customer has been notified if Telegram is connected.` : `\u2139\uFE0F No pending payment was found for customer #${userId}; no duplicate subscription period was created.`
              );
            } else {
              await env.DB.prepare(
                "UPDATE users SET status = 'stopped' WHERE id = ?"
              ).bind(userId).run();
              await env.DB.prepare(
                "UPDATE payments SET status = 'rejected' WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'pending'"
              ).bind(userId).run();
              await sendTelegramMessage(
                env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN,
                chatId,
                `\u274C Customer #${userId} has been stopped.`
              );
            }
          }
        }
        return json({ ok: true });
      }
      if (url.pathname === "/api/security-test-suite") {
        return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
      }
      if (env.ASSETS) {
        let response = await env.ASSETS.fetch(request);
        if (response.status === 404) {
          const indexUrl = new URL("/index.html", request.url);
          response = await env.ASSETS.fetch(new Request(indexUrl, request));
        }
        return response;
      }
      return json({ error: "Not found" }, 404);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Worker request failed:", error);
      return json({ error: "An unexpected server error occurred." }, 500);
    }
  }
};
export {
  worker_default as default
};
